categories.name: Frame Guides
categories.description: Prompt scaffolds for first-frame and first+last-frame H3 workflows.

prompts.title: First-frame only
prompts.prompt: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> is fully referenced. Integrate the reference faithfully at the opening frame, then continue with natural motion and consistent appearance.
prompts.note: Use after connecting a first frame.

prompts.title: First and last frame
prompts.prompt: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video, and Picture 2 aligns with the final frame of the target video. Transition naturally from the first composition to the second while preserving subject identity and scene continuity.
prompts.note: Use after connecting both first and last frame.

prompts.title: Land on final frame
prompts.prompt: The target video should progress naturally and arrive on the reference composition at the final frame, matching the subject, environment, and overall framing.
prompts.note: Use when only the last frame is wired.

categories.name: Continuity & Identity
categories.description: Phrases that help H3 preserve subjects and scenes across motion or shots.

prompts.title: Identity hold
prompts.prompt: Preserve the subject’s facial features, hairstyle, proportions, clothing, and distinguishing details consistently throughout the shot.

prompts.title: Wardrobe hold
prompts.prompt: The wardrobe remains unchanged in color, material, fit, and accessories throughout the sequence.

prompts.title: Scene hold
prompts.prompt: Keep the room layout, furniture placement, practical lights, and background objects spatially consistent.

prompts.title: Prop hold
prompts.prompt: The held object keeps the same size, color, labels, and orientation continuity as it moves through the shot.

prompts.title: Eyeline continuity
prompts.prompt: Maintain believable eyelines and screen direction between the characters.

prompts.title: Motion continuity
prompts.prompt: Motion remains physically continuous with no teleporting, duplicate limbs, or sudden pose resets.

categories.name: Reference Scope Phrases
categories.description: Natural-language reference guidance matching H3 reference roles.

prompts.title: Person only
prompts.prompt: Use the referenced person for identity and appearance while allowing the target scene, pose, and composition to follow this prompt.

prompts.title: Object only
prompts.prompt: Use the referenced object for its appearance and defining details without inheriting the source background.

prompts.title: Scene only
prompts.prompt: Use the referenced environment for spatial layout and atmosphere while placing the prompted subjects naturally within it.

prompts.title: Motion only
prompts.prompt: Borrow the reference video’s action and timing while applying that movement to the prompted subject.

prompts.title: Camera only
prompts.prompt: Borrow the reference video’s camera movement, pacing, and framing changes without copying its visible subject.

prompts.title: Voice only
prompts.prompt: Use the reference audio for voice character and delivery while speaking the dialogue written in this prompt.

categories.name: Multi-Shot Continuity
categories.description: Reusable blocks for timeline pieces and connected shots.

prompts.title: Establish then detail
prompts.prompt: [Shot 1] Establish the location and subject clearly. [Shot 2] Cut closer to the subject’s hands and the important object, preserving wardrobe, lighting direction, and screen direction.

prompts.title: Dialogue coverage
prompts.prompt: [Shot 1] Medium two-shot establishes both speakers. [Shot 2] Over-the-shoulder on the first speaker. [Shot 3] Reverse over-the-shoulder on the second speaker. Preserve eyelines, positions, wardrobe, and room lighting.

prompts.title: Action progression
prompts.prompt: [Shot 1] The subject prepares. [Shot 2] The action begins with continuous movement. [Shot 3] The action resolves in a clean final pose. Keep identity, direction of travel, and object continuity consistent.

prompts.title: Product sequence
prompts.prompt: [Shot 1] Hero establishing view of the product. [Shot 2] Close detail of the key feature in use. [Shot 3] Clean end frame with the product fully readable and unobstructed.

prompts.title: Continue ambience
prompts.prompt: Carry the same room tone, environmental ambience, and musical energy across the cut without an abrupt audio reset.

prompts.title: Intentional hard cut
prompts.prompt: Use a clear hard cut between shots while preserving subject identity and scene geography.

categories.name: Inline Choices
categories.description: Seeded, unseeded, and weighted choice examples.

prompts.title: Seeded choice
prompts.prompt: Cinematic portrait, {soft daylight|warm tungsten|cool fluorescent}, clean background.
prompts.note: Plain braces pick one option using the node seed.

prompts.title: Unseeded choice
prompts.prompt: Street scene, {*light drizzle|gentle wind|passing traffic}, natural ambience.
prompts.note: The * modifier ignores the node seed.

prompts.title: Weighted choice
prompts.prompt: Camera move, {~4 static tripod|~2 slow dolly in|~1 handheld push forward}.

categories.name: Wildcard Paths
categories.description: Wildcard path examples for your My Library folders.

prompts.title: Simple wildcard
prompts.prompt: __characters/lead__, __locations/city__, cinematic audio bed.
prompts.note: Pulls one entry from each wildcard file.

prompts.title: Sequential wildcard
prompts.prompt: __+camera/moves__, clean daylight.
prompts.note: Advances through the file one line at a time.

cast.name: Orin Vex
cast.description: Fictional adult amphibious alien science officer with smooth teal skin, subtle gill ridges, large dark eyes, long dexterous fingers, and a calm analytical presence. Keep the same non-human facial structure, skin markings and proportions across shots.
cast.clothing: a clean charcoal exploration uniform with practical pockets and a compact instrument harness

cast.name: Tala Quill
cast.description: Fictional adult lavender-skinned alien navigator with four symmetrical eyes, a narrow elegant face, short swept-back cranial fins, and a tall slim silhouette. Keep the same four-eye layout, fin shape and markings across shots.
cast.clothing: a fitted navy navigation jacket with soft shoulder panels and simple utility trousers

cast.name: Bronn Kest
